served_exception.text: Not met, excepted: {exception}, requested by {requester}, approved by {approver}, in force at {reference_time} by the server's clock, until {until}.

project_exception.text: Not met, excepted by the project's own file: {exception}; the file names {approver} as approver, which nothing checks; until {until}.

suppressed_in_source_excepted.text: Not checked: suppressed in the source, covered by the project's exception {exception}.

suppressed_in_source_not_excepted.text: Not checked: suppressed in the source, covered by no exception.

not_yet_in_force.text: Not met. Exception {exception} is not yet in force: it starts on {starts_at}.

for_another_environment.text: Not met. Exception {exception} is for the environment {exception_environment}, not {environment}.

run_names_no_environment.text: Not met. Exception {exception} is for the environment {exception_environment}, and the run names no environment.

approved_for_another_document_of_the_ass.text: Not met. Exception {exception} was approved for another version of this assertion.

approved_after_the_reference_time.text: Not met. Exception {exception} was approved at {approved_at}, after the stage's reference time {reference_time}.

every_failure_excepted.text: Not met, every failure excepted: the gate let the pipeline go on.

advisory_let_through.text: Advisory: the gate let the pipeline go on despite results not met or undecided: {not_met} not met, {undecided} undecided.

incomplete_stopped.text: Incomplete: a required check was not made or its evaluator failed, so the gate stopped the pipeline, even in advisory mode.

run_statement.text: The server that opened the run accepted this record and signed for it: a run statement it signed with a trusted key lists this record. This says the server accepted the record, not that the change met its checks.

run_opened_locally.text: A local run, opened by the CLI, not by a server: only the record's writer vouches for it, and no server signs for it.

no_statement_given.text: The record says a server opened the run, and no run statement was given, so only the record's writer vouches for it.

refused_by_server.text: The run statement says the server refused this record.

run_statement_does_not_hold.text: The run statement given could not be verified, or does not match this record; the problems listed say why.

integrity_failed.text: A file the record cites does not match the digest the record names, or the record breaks one of its own rules, so nothing the record says about itself is taken.

iltero.text: The run statement is signed by Iltero's key {key_id}; the list of trusted keys checked has the digest {trust_data_digest}.

operator.text: The run statement is signed by {operator}'s server, key {key_id}, which the operator trust file {operator_file} lists ({trust_data_digest}); Iltero did not sign it.
